sidebar.title: Portfolio
sidebar.subtitle: Websites & Digital Tools for Local Businesses in Bolzano
sidebar.description:
I help cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and small businesses create simple, mobile-friendly websites that make it easier for customers to view your services, contact you, book appointments, or send enquiries through WhatsApp.

Based in Bolzano, Italy. Available for freelance website, menu, booking, and automation projects for local businesses.

about.title: About
about.description:
I help cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, nail studios, and small local businesses in Bolzano and South Tyrol build simple, mobile-friendly digital tools that make it easier for customers to find you, view your services, contact you, order, or book.

My focus is on practical solutions that small businesses can actually use: clean websites, digital menus, WhatsApp enquiry buttons, booking forms, and simple dashboards.

Whether you need a new website, a digital menu for your cafe, a booking page for your salon, or a simple way for customers to enquire about your products, I build solutions that are easy for your customers to use and simple for you to manage.

whatIBuild.title: Business Websites
whatIBuild.description: Mobile-friendly websites for cafes, restaurants, bakeries, salons, and local service businesses. Designed to look professional, load fast, and help customers quickly understand what you offer.

whatIBuild.title: Digital Menus & Product Pages
whatIBuild.description: Online menus and product pages that customers can browse from their phone. Ideal for restaurants, cafes, bakeries, home bakers, salons, and small shops.

whatIBuild.title: WhatsApp & Contact Enquiry Flows
whatIBuild.description: Simple enquiry flows that guide customers from browsing to contacting you directly through WhatsApp, a contact form, or a phone call.

whatIBuild.title: Booking & Appointment Pages
whatIBuild.description: Online booking pages for salons, studios, restaurants, and service-based businesses. Customers can request a time, and you receive the details clearly.

whatIBuild.title: Simple Admin Dashboards
whatIBuild.description: Private dashboards to manage menu items, products, enquiries, bookings, and basic business updates without needing technical knowledge.

whyItWorks.title: Local in Bolzano
whyItWorks.description: Based locally and familiar with small-business needs in Bolzano and South Tyrol. I understand the local market and your customers.

whyItWorks.title: Mobile-First Design
whyItWorks.description: Most customers search and browse from their phones. Every website is designed mobile-first so your visitors can take action quickly.

whyItWorks.title: Simple Contact Flows
whyItWorks.description: Websites include clear ways for customers to reach you through WhatsApp, contact forms, booking requests, or enquiry buttons.

whyItWorks.title: Multilingual Ready
whyItWorks.description: Websites can be structured for English, Italian, and German content, helping both local and tourist customers understand your services.

whyItWorks.title: Clean & Premium Design
whyItWorks.description: Simple, professional layouts without unnecessary complexity. Your website represents your business, and it should look the part.

whyItWorks.title: Optional Monthly Support
whyItWorks.description: After launch, I can help with updates, content changes, small fixes, and general maintenance so your site stays fresh and working.

services.title: Services
services.description: I build practical digital tools that small businesses can actually use: clean websites, digital menus, service pages, booking or contact flows, WhatsApp enquiry buttons, and simple admin dashboards.

items.title: Business Website
items.description: A clean, mobile-friendly website tailored to your business. Includes key sections such as home, about, services or products, gallery, contact, location, and enquiry buttons.

items.title: Digital Menu / Product Catalogue
items.description: A structured online menu or product catalogue where customers can browse items, categories, prices, descriptions, and photos from their phone.

items.title: WhatsApp Order Flow
items.description: A simple order or enquiry flow connected to WhatsApp, allowing customers to contact you directly after viewing your products or services.

items.title: Booking / Reservation Flow

items.title: Admin Dashboard
items.description: A private dashboard where you can manage menu items, products, enquiries, bookings, or basic content updates.
